text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Refusing to give up the lead,
it's Daiwa Scarlet--!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaahhh--!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: A-Awesome! That three-way showdown was so exciting!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I came today! I feel like I just saw something incredible...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...! I won!
Against Vodka, and Chan-chan too...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Nnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...
Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations.
...You were incredible. I couldn't catch up to you.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I'm frustrated after all.
So—let's race again.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: With Scarlett, Vodka, and Machan.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Chan-chan...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yes, without fail...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Well, see you later~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A thunderous round of applause enveloped Aston Machan as she headed toward the tunnel.
As if drawn by it, she looked up at the stands.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Chan, that was so close!
But you were amazing!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I never thought I'd get to see a Big Three showdown again!
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Pleasant sounds, lovely scenery.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Any place where I stand alongside those two
always becomes so vibrant.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Mar-chan is blessed with friends...
and with rivals."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you,
Vodka, Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Until next time, somewhere out there. Without fail.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Let us fight, together.
